dimensions.evidenceA: Death remains named, though human life is greatly extended.
dimensions.label: Death

dimensions.evidenceA: People build, plant, eat, and have days like a tree.
dimensions.evidenceB: God dwells with people, wipes tears, and gives life-water.
dimensions.label: Life setting

evidence.observation: In the promised new heavens and new earth, one who dies at one hundred is described as a child.
Death will be no more, and mourning, crying, and pain will pass away.

record.tension: Isaiah 65 includes death within its new-creation promise, while Revelation 21 says that death will be no more.
record.title: Does death remain in the new creation?
